outcomeNote: An anonymous mishna laying out cases of asham talui and its count by analogy to the sin offering; no named parties interact.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ סָפֵק אָכַל חֵלֶב, סָפֵק לֹא אָכַל, וַאֲפִילּוּ אָכַל, סָפֵק יֵשׁ בּוֹ כַּשִּׁיעוּר וְסָפֵק
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If there is «uncertainty» whether «one ate» forbidden «fat» and «uncertainty» whether «one did not eat» forbidden «fat, or even» if «one ate» forbidden fat and there is «uncertainty» whether «there is the measure» that determines liability «in» the piece he ate «and uncertainty»
whether «there is not» the measure that determines liability «in» the piece he ate, he must bring a provisional guilt offering.

segments.he: שׁוּמָּן וָחֵלֶב לְפָנָיו, וְאָכַל אֶחָד מֵהֶן וְאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ אֵיזֶה מֵהֶן אָכַל, אִשְׁתּוֹ וַאֲחוֹתוֹ עִמּוֹ בַּבַּיִת, שָׁגַג בְּאַחַת מֵהֶן וְאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ בְּאֵיזוֹ מֵהֶן שָׁגַג, שַׁבָּת וְיוֹם חוֹל, וְעָשָׂה מְלָאכָה בְּאֶחָד מֵהֶן וְאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ בְּאֵיזֶה מֵהֶן עָשָׂה – מֵבִיא אָשָׁם תָּלוּי.
segments.en: If one has a piece of permitted «fat and» a piece of forbidden «fat before him and he ate one of them and he does not know which of them he ate;» or if «his wife and his sister» were «with him in the house» and «he unwittingly» engaged in intercourse «with one of them and he does not know with which of them he unwittingly» engaged in intercourse; or if he confused «Shabbat and a weekday and he performed labor» prohibited on Shabbat «on one of» the days «and he does not know on which of them he performed» the labor, in all of those cases he is liable to «bring a provisional guilt offering.»

segments.he: כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאִם אָכַל חֵלֶב וָחֵלֶב בְּהֶעְלֵם (אַחַת) [אֶחָד] אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב אֶלָּא חַטָּאת אַחַת, כֵּן עַל לֹא הוֹדַע שֶׁלָּהֶן אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶלָּא אָשָׁם תָּלוּי אֶחָד.
segments.en: «Just as» in a case «where one» unknowingly «ate» a piece of forbidden «fat and» then another piece of forbidden «fat in a single lapse of awareness» he is «liable» to bring «only one sin offering, so too, in» a case where their status is «unknown» to him and he ate them both unwittingly during a single lapse in awareness, he is «liable» to bring «only one provisional guilt offering.»

segments.he: אִם הָיְתָה יְדִיעָה בֵּינָתַיִם, כְּשֵׁם שֶׁהוּא מֵבִיא חַטָּאת עַל כׇּל אַחַת וְאֶחָת, כָּךְ מֵבִיא אָשָׁם תָּלוּי עַל כׇּל אַחַת וְאֶחָת.
segments.en: But «if» he «had» gained «knowledge between» the first and second instance of eating that there is a possibility the fat might be prohibited, then the halakha is different: «Just as he» would be liable to «bring a sin offering for each and every» piece when he gained knowledge of their prohibited status in between each act of consumption, «so too,» he must «bring a provisional guilt offering for each and every» instance in which he consumed food that might be forbidden after learning of their uncertain status in between each unwitting act of consumption.

segments.he: כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאָכַל חֵלֶב וָדָם וּפִיגּוּל וְנוֹתָר בְּהֶעְלֵם אַחַת חַיָּיב עַל כׇּל אַחַת וְאֶחָת, כָּךְ עַל לֹא הוֹדַע שֶׁלָּהֶן מֵבִיא אָשָׁם תָּלוּי עַל כׇּל אַחַת וְאֶחָת.
segments.en: «Just as» in a case «where one ate» forbidden «fat, and blood, and piggul, and notar in one lapse of awareness he is liable» to bring a sin offering «for each and every one, so too, with regard» to a case where «their» status is «unknown» to him and he ate them unwittingly during one lapse of awareness, he must «bring a provisional guilt offering for each and every» item.

moves.summary: uncertainty whether one ate forbidden fat, or whether it was a full measure, obligates a provisional guilt offering
uncertainty which of two items/women/days was the forbidden one: permitted and forbidden fat, wife and sister, Shabbat and weekday — he brings a provisional guilt offering

moves.cueHe: כשם שאם אכל חלב וחלב בהעלם אחד
moves.summary: just as two pieces of fat in one lapse of awareness require one sin offering, so their unknown status requires only one provisional guilt offering
if awareness intervened between the acts, a separate provisional guilt offering is owed for each, as with sin offerings

moves.cueHe: כשם שאכל חלב ודם ופיגול ונותר
moves.summary: just as eating fat, blood, piggul and notar in one lapse requires a sin offering for each, so uncertainty about them requires a provisional guilt offering for each

positions.claim: doubt whether one ate forbidden fat, or whether it was a full measure, or which of two pieces/women/days was the forbidden one, obligates a provisional guilt offering

the number of provisional guilt offerings parallels the number of sin offerings: one for several pieces of fat in one lapse of awareness, one per act if awareness intervened, one per distinct prohibition
positions.basis: analogy to the laws of the sin offering (כשם ש... כך)
